title: Set Fleet up for Deploy App
breadcrumb: Set Fleet up for Deploy App

slides.title: What Fleet needs
slides.html: Fleet needs three things for Deploy App: Android turned on, a team for this Deploy App's phones and an API token for the connector.

slides.title: Android turned on
slides.html: In Fleet: Settings, Integrations, MDM must say Android MDM turned on. If not, whoever runs Fleet connects Android Enterprise there: once, for all teams.

slides.title: A team named after your deployment
slides.html: Name the team with your deployment's name and DeployApp, such as golden-monkey DeployApp: anyone in Fleet then sees which team belongs to which Deploy App. Fleet's console calls a team a fleet.

slides.title: The connector makes it
slides.html: Least work: the connector makes the team at Connect, from the name on its Team card. To make it yourself: Settings, Fleets, Add fleet, type the name and press Create.

slides.title: An API token
slides.html: The connector needs a global admin's API token. One from My account, Get API token ends with that sign-in, after 5 days by default; an API-only user's does not end.

slides.title: An API-only user
slides.html: Whoever runs Fleet makes one: Settings, Users, Add user, API-only user, with the role Admin for all of Fleet (Global). They then give you its token.

slides.title: One Fleet, one Deploy App
slides.html: With the connector, one Fleet serves one Deploy App. A second Deploy App needs a Fleet of its own.

slides.title: Fleet's address
slides.html: When the connector asks what your MDM needs, type the address you open Fleet at on Fleet address, and press Next.

slides.title: The token
slides.html: Paste the token and press Next. With Remember on this computer ticked, the keychain keeps it for the next start.

slides.title: The team
slides.html: Team suggests your deployment's name with DeployApp, such as golden-monkey DeployApp: leave it, and leave More settings as they are. Press Connect: the team is made if it is not there.

slides.title: What Connect sets up
slides.html: Fleet gets Deploy App as a certificate authority, and the team gets the certificate, the policy, the apps and the Deploy App icon. Then go on at It sets your MDM up in Connect your MDM.
